title: Cancel hidden response through cross-operation information
statement: Cross-operation weighted return Grams detect whether a nonnegative mixture makes every next-visible row independent of hidden memory. The reviewed source A compiles useful exact one-call controls, while source B has the same complete isolated-operation paths but strictly decreasing positive centered multipliers, excluding any useful exact finite open-loop word mixture. This is not an exclusion of useful approximate or feedback controls.
